items.stem: 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 나머지와 다른 것은?
items.explain: harm(해를 끼치다) – heal(치료하다)은 반의어, 나머지는 유의어.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Words 심화 B(path≒way, producer≒maker) · L6 Words 심화 B(form=build, harm↔heal) · L6 Words 기본 A(collect)

items.stem: 다음 대화의 (가)~(라)에 들어갈 수 없는 표현은?
items.box:
G: (가), when you grow up?
B: I want to be a pet trainer.
G: A pet trainer?
B: Yes, (나) training pets. I often teach my dogs skills at home.
G: That’s so cool! (다) teach my dog some skills, too?
B: (라)
choices: What do you want to be
items.explain: (가) What do you want to be (나) I’m interested in (다) Why don’t you (라) I’d love to! — ⑤는 쓰이지 않는다.
items.source: L5 Review Lounge 1

items.stem: 주어진 말에 이어질 대화 (A)~(D)의 순서로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.box:
G: I can’t finish this sandwich.
(A) G: Why?
(B) B: You know what? Wasting food is bad for the Earth.
(C) B: Food waste makes greenhouse gases.
(D) G: Oh, I get it. I’ll bring less food next time.
items.explain: 음식 낭비가 지구에 나쁘다(B) → 왜?(A) → 온실가스를 만든다(C) → 알겠다, 덜 가져오겠다(D).
items.source: L6 Listen & Speak A-4

lines: Kate: Jia, how much trash (A)[did you pick / have you picked] up?
Jia: I have picked up five bags.
Kate: Really? I couldn’t even fill two bags.
Jia: I come here often, so I know where to find the trash.
Kate: Do you go plogging in the mountains often?
Jia: Yes. I (B)[plogged / have plogged] for a year.
Kate: Wow, you’re great.
Jia: (C)[Although / Because] it is hard, I’m happy to help the Earth. It’s also good for my health.
Kate: That’s true. The air is so fresh.
Jia: How was today for you?
Kate: I was happy to help the planet (D)[because / although] I didn’t pick up much.

items.stem: (A)~(D)에 들어갈 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: (A) 지금까지 주운 양 → 현재완료 have you picked (B) for a year → 현재완료 계속 (C)(D) ‘힘들지만/많이 줍지 못했지만’ 양보 → although.
items.source: L6 Language Use C (Kate·Jia) — 현재완료·although(학습지 L6 GP-A·B)

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: How many bags of trash has Jia picked up?
Why does Jia know where to find the trash?
How many times a week does Kate go plogging?
How did Kate feel about today?
items.explain: Kate 가 일주일에 몇 번 플로깅을 가는지는 나오지 않는다. ① five bags ② for a year ③ 자주 오기 때문 ⑤ happy.
items.source: L6 Language Use C

items.stem: 위 대화에 대한 설명 ⓐ~ⓘ 중 옳은 것의 개수는?
items.box:
ⓐ Jia has picked up more bags of trash than Kate.
ⓑ Kate filled two bags of trash.
ⓒ Jia has plogged for a year.
ⓓ Kate goes plogging in the mountains more often than Jia.
ⓔ where to find the trash 는 where she should find the trash 로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
ⓕ I have picked up five bags. 의 현재완료는 ‘경험’의 용법이다.
ⓖ 이 대화에서 hard 는 ‘열심히’라는 뜻으로 쓰였다.
ⓗ Although it is hard 는 It is hard, but 의 의미이다.
ⓘ I was happy to help the planet 의 to help 는 감정의 원인을 나타내는 부사적 용법이다.
items.explain: 옳은 것: ⓐ(5봉지 > 2봉지 못 채움) ⓒ ⓔ(의문사+to부정사 = 의문사+주어+should+동사) ⓗ ⓘ → 5개. ⓑ 두 봉지도 못 채움, ⓓ 자주 가는 것은 Jia, ⓕ 완료 용법, ⓖ ‘힘든’.
items.source: L6 Language Use C · 학습지 L6 p.6(의문사+to부정사 복습) · 학습지 L6 GP-A(현재완료 용법) · L6 어휘(hard) · 문제집 L1 GRAMMAR(부사적 용법 감정의 원인)

items.stem: 다음 우리말을 가주어 It 과 주어진 말을 이용하여 어법상 바르게 영작한 것은?
items.box: 그가 문을 열어 주다니 친절하다. (kind, open the door)
choices: It is kind for him to open the door.
It is kind of him to open the door.
It is kind of he to open the door.
That is kind of him to open the door.
It is kind of him opening the door.
items.explain: kind 처럼 사람의 성격을 나타내는 형용사 뒤의 의미상 주어는 「of + 목적격」, 진주어는 to부정사, 가주어는 It.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Grammar Point A – B-3 · 통합본 L5 GRAMMAR 1

lines: Why Do We Work?

First, we work (A)<u>to make</u> money. Our jobs help us get paid so we can make a living. Second, we work (B)<u>to take on</u> social roles. For example, street cleaners keep our towns and cities clean, and police officers make our society safe. We rely on others to do these important jobs, and everyone has a special role (C)<u>to play</u>. Third, we work (D)<u>to feel</u> proud of our work. By working, we can help others and show our abilities. In the end, we work (E)<u>to find</u> meaning in life.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중, to부정사의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
items.explain: (C) to play 는 role 을 꾸미는 형용사적 용법. 나머지는 ‘~하기 위해’ 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법.
items.source: L5 본문 2대목(Why Do We Work?) · 통합본 L5 본문 분석(형용사적/부사적 용법)

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: 우리는 돈을 벌어 생계를 유지하기 위해 일한다.
거리 청소부와 경찰관은 사회적 역할을 맡는 예이다.
모든 사람에게는 맡은 특별한 역할이 있다.
일을 통해 우리는 남을 돕고 능력을 보여 줄 수 있다.
우리가 일하는 궁극적인 이유는 사회적 역할을 맡는 것이다.
items.explain: In the end, we work to find meaning in life. — 결국 삶의 의미를 찾기 위해 일한다.
items.source: L5 본문 2대목

items.stem: 윗글에 대한 설명 ⓐ~ⓙ 중 옳지 않은 것의 개수는?
items.box:
ⓐ help us get paid 의 get 은 to get 으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
ⓑ so we can make a living 의 so 는 ‘그래서’라는 뜻으로 결과를 나타낸다.
ⓒ keep our towns and cities clean 의 clean 은 cleanly 로 고쳐야 한다.
ⓓ make our society safe 의 make 는 ‘~을 …하게 만들다’라는 뜻이다.
ⓔ everyone has 는 everyone have 로 고쳐야 한다.
ⓕ By working 의 working 은 ‘~함으로써’의 의미로 쓰인 동명사이다.
ⓖ role: a part that someone has in an activity or situation
ⓗ ability: the main idea that people talk or write about
ⓘ society: people living together in a community
ⓙ proud: feeling pleased and satisfied about something that you own or have done
items.explain: 옳지 않은 것: ⓑ(so = ~하도록, 목적) ⓒ(keep+목적어+형용사) ⓔ(everyone 은 단수 취급) ⓗ(topic 의 풀이; ability 는 the power or skill to do something) → 4개.
items.source: 통합본 L5 본문 분석 · 학습지 L5 Reading B(p.89) · L5 영영풀이 · 학습지 L5 Words 기본 A-2

lines: Date & Time: October 2, 10:00 a.m.
I have thought about how to help corals.
(A) I’m sure that other divers are worried about this, too. I’m going to post a message online to look for (가)<u>volunteer</u> divers.
(B) My plan is to form a team of divers. My team can go underwater and take care of the sick corals.
(C) Many corals get sick because they don’t get good care in time.

items.stem: 주어진 글에 이어질 (A)~(C)의 순서로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: 계획: 잠수부 팀(B) → 산호가 아픈 이유(C) → 다른 잠수부들도 걱정할 것이니 자원봉사자 모집(A).
items.source: L6 본문 2대목(October 2)

items.stem: 윗글의 (가)volunteer 의 영영풀이로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: someone who does something without being paid or forced to do it
a person who makes decisions in court
a person who helps by listening and talking
someone in charge of preparing and producing a play, film, or show
items.explain: volunteer 자원봉사자. ② judge ③ vet ④ counselor ⑤ producer.
items.source: 학습지 L6 Words 심화 C-ⓔ · 학습지 L5 Words 기본 A

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
items.box: I have taught math at this school ________.
items.explain: 현재완료는 ~ ago, yesterday, last ~ 같은 과거 시간 부사(구)와 함께 쓸 수 없다.
items.source: 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR 1 · 학습지 L6 Grammar Point A

items.stem: 「명령문, and/or …」를 If 로 시작하는 문장으로 어법상 바르게 바꾼 것은?
choices:
Hurry up, or you’ll miss the bus.
→ If you hurry up, you’ll miss the bus.

Keep trying, and you’ll achieve your goals.
→ If you don’t keep trying, you’ll achieve your goals.

Follow the rules, or you’ll get in trouble.
→ If you don’t follow the rules, you’ll get in trouble.

Take the subway, and you’ll save money.
→ If you will take the subway, you’ll save money.

Study hard, or you’ll fail the test.
→ If you study hard, you’ll fail the test.
items.explain: 「명령문, or」= If + 주어 + don’t/doesn’t ~. ①⑤ or 인데 긍정 if, ② and 인데 부정 if, ④ 조건절에 will 을 쓰지 않는다.
items.source: 통합본 L5 GRAMMAR 2 · 학습지 L5 Grammar Point B

lines: Date & Time: November 27, 11:30 a.m.

Last night, some healthy corals in the sea laid eggs ( ⓐ ) the full moon. This morning, hundreds ( ⓑ ) baby corals were born ( ⓒ ) the eggs like magic. They were cute and amazing. I hope this miracle will happen ( ⓓ ) other sick corals, too. Although it took time (가)<u>to heal</u> the sick corals and grow healthy ones, it was worth the hard work.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓓ에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
items.explain: ⓐ during the full moon ⓑ hundreds of ⓒ born from the eggs ⓓ happen to.
items.source: L6 본문 4대목(November 27) · L6 어휘(hundreds of)

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (가)to heal 과 to부정사의 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: It is important for him to finish the project.
My plan is to form a team of divers.
Everyone has a special role to play.
First, we work to make money.
I was happy to help the planet.
items.explain: it took time to heal ~ 에서 it 은 가주어, to heal 이하가 진주어(명사적 용법·주어). ①도 가주어–진주어. ② 보어 ③ 형용사적 ④ 부사적(목적) ⑤ 부사적(감정의 원인).
items.source: 학습지 L6 p.8(it 가주어·진주어) · 학습지 L5 Grammar Point A · 통합본 본문 분석

items.stem: 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 모두 한 번씩 사용하여 영작할 때, 여덟 번째에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
비록 이전에는 크게 신경 쓰지 않았지만, 이제부터 지구에 더 친절해질 것이다.
(although, before, be, care, didn’t, Earth, from, I, I, kinder, much, now, on, the, to, will)
items.explain: Although I didn’t care much before, I will be kinder to the Earth from now on. → 8번째 will.
items.source: L6 Think & Write STEP 1 · 학습지 L6 Grammar Point B(although)

items.stem: 두 문장의 의미가 잘 드러나도록 현재완료 문장으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
choices:
Spring came, and it is spring now.
→ Spring has come.

Eddie lost his cap, and he still can’t find it.
→ Eddie has lose his cap.

My parents went to Hong Kong, and they are still in Hong Kong now.
→ My parents have been to Hong Kong.

I started to wear glasses in 2024, and I still wear them.
→ I have worn glasses for 2024.

He joined the reading club two years ago, and he is still in the club.
→ He has been in the reading club since two years.
items.explain: ② has lost ③ have gone to(가 버려서 지금 없음) ④ since 2024 ⑤ for two years.
items.source: 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR 1 – C · 학습지 L6 Grammar Point A

lines: How Can I Find My Job?

Everyone has their own favorite activities. Try to connect them to a real job, ①<u>or</u> you will find your path. If you like ②<u>watching</u> TV shows, you can be a producer or a writer for those shows. (B)________, liking something and being good at it are not the same. Playing soccer as a job ③<u>are</u> different from playing it as a hobby. You love soccer but aren’t good at it. Then you can look for other jobs in soccer. If you are good at taking care of people, you can become a soccer player’s manager. Or you can work as a marketer for a soccer team if you are good at thinking creatively. Look for jobs ④<u>who</u> match your favorite things and your abilities.
What Do I Have to Do Now?

First, focus on your school subjects now. They give you the basic skills for your future. These skills help you ⑤<u>making</u> good choices. Second, gather information about jobs that interest you. You can watch videos and movies, or read books about them. This way, you can learn about real work in those jobs. Finally, keep trying new things! Your interests can change often. (A)<u>여러분이 다양한 활동을 경험하는 것은 매우 중요하다.</u> Our world keeps changing, and jobs will also change. Keep exploring, and you’ll find your dream job soon.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)를 바르게 영작한 문장은?
choices: It is very important for you to experience different activities.
It is very important of you to experience different activities.
It is very important for you experiencing different activities.
That is very important for you to experience different activities.
It is very important for your to experience different activities.
items.explain: 가주어 It + important + 의미상 주어 for you + 진주어 to experience.
items.source: L5 본문 4대목 · 통합본 L5 GRAMMAR 1

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 앞에서 ‘좋아하는 것을 직업과 연결하라’고 했고, 뒤에서 ‘좋아하는 것과 잘하는 것은 다르다’로 흐름이 바뀌므로 However.
items.source: L5 본문 3대목

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
items.explain: ① and(~해라, 그러면) ③ 동명사구 주어는 단수 → is ④ 선행사 jobs → that/which ⑤ help + 목적어 + 동사원형/to부정사 → make. ② like + 동명사 옳음.
items.source: L5 본문 3·4대목(원문: and / is / that / make) · 통합본 L5 GRAMMAR 2 · 학습지 L5 p.8 노트(동명사 주어 단수·관계대명사) · 통합본 본문 분석(help+목적어+동사원형)

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: What can you be if you like watching TV shows?
What job can you have if you are good at taking care of people?
How many jobs are there in soccer?
Why should you focus on your school subjects now?
How can you gather information about jobs?
items.explain: 축구 관련 직업의 수는 언급되지 않는다. ① producer or writer ② soccer player’s manager ④ basic skills for your future ⑤ videos, movies, books.
items.source: L5 본문 3·4대목

lines: Date & Time: September 15, 5:30 p.m.

It’s a sad day for me. This morning, I went scuba diving at my favorite (가) in the sea. It was a place ⓐ<u>that</u> was full of beautiful and colorful corals. But today, I saw that corals ⓑ<u>were getting</u> sick. I was ⓒ<u>shocking</u>. Because of the warm seawater, corals have turned white. Different types of waste ⓓ<u>have harmed</u> the corals, too. (A)<u>Now the (가) has lost its colors and beauty.</u> I’m really ⓔ<u>worried</u>.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 (가)에 공통으로 들어갈 단어가 아래 ①~⑤의 빈칸에 쓰였을 때, 문맥상 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: He changed his ______ at the last moment.
There is a ______ on your shirt.
Our hen ______ an egg this morning.
She used a ______ to light the campfire.
items.explain: (가) spot(지점, 장소). ② spot(얼룩). ① mind ③ laid ④ match ⑤ match.
items.source: L6 본문 1대목 · L5·L6 다의어(mind, match, lay, spot)

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 의미를 가장 잘 설명한 것은?
choices: The spot lost its colors, but it has them now.
The spot lost its colors, so it doesn’t have them now.
The spot lost its colors, and it found them later.
The spot may lose its colors in the future.
The spot loses its colors every year.
items.explain: has lost 는 현재완료 ‘결과’ 용법 — 잃어버려서 지금도 없다.
items.source: L6 본문 1대목 · 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR 1(결과 용법) · 학습지 L6 p.6

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
items.explain: ‘나는 충격을 받았다’ — 감정을 느끼는 주어 → 과거분사형 형용사 shocked. ⓐ 주격 관계대명사 ⓑ 과거진행 ⓓ 현재완료 ⓔ worried 옳음.
items.source: L6 본문 1대목(원문 shocked) · 학습지 L6 p.6·p.8(shocking/shocked, amazing/amazed)

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: to have a bad effect on something
unhappy because you think something bad might happen
a hard, rock-like thing made by tiny sea animals living together
a soft cream used on the skin to treat a medical problem
items.explain: ① spot ② harm ③ worried ④ coral 은 글에 있고, ⑤ ointment 는 없다.
items.source: 학습지 L6 Crossword(spot·harm) · L6 영영풀이(worried·ointment) · 학습지 L6 Words 심화 C-ⓐ(coral)

items.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
items.box: Corals are very important for our oceans. Many sea animals live near them. Corals also keep sea animals safe from big waves and storms. They are like walls. Corals clean the air, too. They take in greenhouse gases from the water. This helps reduce these gases in the ocean and the air.
choices: Many sea animals live near corals.
Corals keep sea animals safe from big waves and storms.
Corals make greenhouse gases in the water.
Corals help reduce greenhouse gases in the ocean and the air.
items.explain: 산호는 온실가스를 만드는 것이 아니라 흡수한다(take in).
items.source: L6 Before Reading A — 기출 27(그래프)을 글 일치로 대체

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
• It is difficult me to learn a new language.
• Be kind to others, and they will respect you.
• It was polite of he to hold the door for the next person.
• I have studied English for three years.
• Although rained it heavily, the flight was not delayed.
• Even though the heater is on, it is still cold here.
• If we will hurry, we can catch the bus.
• The teacher made us clean the classroom.
items.explain: 옳은 것: Be kind ~ / I have studied ~ / Even though ~ / The teacher made us clean ~ → 4개. 틀린 것: difficult for me / of him / Although it rained / If we hurry.
